F3D.Title: 3D View
F3D.HUD.ClearConfirm: Reset every square of this scene to height 0?
F3D.HUD.PaintHint: Click a square to raise it, right-click or Shift+click to lower. Drag still moves the camera.
F3D.Notify.NoScene: 3D View: there is no active scene to show.
F3D.Notify.SquareOnly: 3D View only supports square (or gridless) scenes for now.
F3D.Settings.WallHeight.Name: Wall height (squares)
F3D.Settings.WallHeight.Hint: Default height of walls in grid squares. Walls with Wall Height module flags use those values instead.
F3D.Settings.HeightStep.Name: Height paint step (squares)
F3D.Settings.HeightStep.Hint: How much one click raises or lowers a square, in grid squares (0.5 on a 5 ft grid = 2.5 ft).
F3D.Settings.ShowGrid.Name: Show grid in 3D
F3D.Settings.ShowGrid.Hint: Draw grid lines on top of the 3D terrain.
F3D.Settings.Fog3d.Name: Fog of war in 3D
F3D.Settings.Fog3d.Hint: Players only see the squares their tokens can see (explored squares stay dimmed). Uses the scene's token vision setting.
F3D.Settings.WallMode.Name: Wall look in 3D
F3D.Settings.WallMode.Hint: Inherit from the map: wall tops show the map and faces take the colours of the wall as drawn on the map. Texture: tile the wall texture below. Flat: plain grey.
F3D.Settings.WallTexture.Name: Wall texture
F3D.Settings.WallTexture.Hint: Image tiled on walls when the wall look is "Wall texture". Individual walls can override it in their configuration sheet.
F3D.Settings.DoorTexture.Name: Door texture
F3D.Settings.DoorTexture.Hint: Optional image for doors (in any wall look). Empty: the module's wooden door. Doors never use the wall texture.
F3D.Settings.WallTextureScale.Name: Wall texture size (squares)
F3D.Settings.WallTextureScale.Hint: How many grid squares one repeat of the wall/door texture covers.
F3D.WallConfig.TextureHint: Foundry 3D View: image tiled on this wall (or door) in the 3D view. Empty uses the module setting.
F3D.Settings.WindowTexture.Name: Window texture
F3D.Settings.WindowTexture.Hint: Optional image tiled on window walls (the frame around the opening). Empty: windows follow the wall look.
F3D.Settings.WindowOpenings.Name: Windows with an opening
F3D.Settings.WindowOpenings.Hint: Draw Foundry window walls (sight: proximity) with an opening and a glass pane. Off: windows are solid walls.
F3D.Settings.InvisibleWalls.Name: Invisible walls
F3D.Settings.InvisibleWalls.Hint: Walls that block movement but not sight. Glass: a see-through panel so they keep their volume. Hide: not drawn.
F3D.Settings.GlassTexture.Name: Glass texture
F3D.Settings.GlassTexture.Hint: Optional image (use a PNG with transparency) for invisible walls and window panes. Empty: tinted transparent glass.
F3D.Settings.UseLevelHeight.Name: Walls span their level (v14)
F3D.Settings.UseLevelHeight.Hint: Foundry v14: a wall without its own height spans its scene level's height (bottom to top) instead of the default wall height.
F3D.WallConfig.HeightHint: Height of this wall in grid squares above the ground: 0.5 = half wall, 0.25 = low wall. Empty uses the module setting.
F3D.WallTools.Title: 3D look of selected walls
F3D.WallTools.SelectFirst: Select one or more walls first (Walls controls, click or drag to select).
F3D.WallTools.Count: Applies to {n} selected wall(s). Leave a field empty to keep it.
F3D.Settings.CameraMode.Name: 3D camera
F3D.Settings.CameraMode.Hint: Free: perspective camera you can orbit freely. Tactics: Final Fantasy Tactics style orthographic camera at a fixed angle on a diagonal, rotated in 90° steps (buttons or Q/E). Also a toggle in the 3D toolbar.
F3D.Settings.SpriteFacing.Name: Token sprites
F3D.Settings.SpriteFacing.Hint: Standee: upright card turned toward the camera. Billboard: always parallel to the screen, like FFT/Doom sprites. Fixed: a paper standee that follows the token's rotation.
F3D.TokenConfig.Hint: Optional image used in 3D instead of the token art. Rows = view directions (4: front, left, back, right; 8: front, front-left, left, back-left, back, back-right, right, front-right), columns = animation frames. The token's rotation is its facing (0 = facing down the map).
F3D.Settings.FoundryLighting.Name: Use Foundry lighting in 3D
F3D.Settings.FoundryLighting.Hint: Shade the 3D view with Foundry's own rendered lighting and vision (animated and coloured lights, darkness, darkvision, the selected token's vision), sampled several times a second while the 3D view is full screen. In window mode a light map computed from the light sources is used instead.
F3D.Settings.CombatFollow.Name: Follow combat turns
F3D.Settings.CombatFollow.Hint: During combat the 3D camera pans to the combatant whose turn it is (if you can see it), which is also marked with a green ring.
F3D.Settings.MirrorAnimations.Name: Show combat animations in 3D
F3D.Settings.MirrorAnimations.Hint: Mirror Sequencer effects (used by Automated Animations and similar modules) in the 3D view, using the same video the 2D effect plays.
F3D.TileConfig.ModelFileHint: A custom file wins over the built-in model. The model fills the tile's footprint and follows its rotation.
F3D.Notify.OutOfRange: That square is out of this token's movement range.
F3D.Settings.LimitMovement.Name: Movement range in 3D (Fire Emblem style)
F3D.Settings.LimitMovement.Hint: Selecting a token shows the squares it can reach (blue) and attack (red); players can only move inside the blue squares. Walls, closed doors, ledges and enemies block. The GM can move anywhere.
F3D.Settings.MoveRange.Name: Default movement range (squares)
F3D.Settings.MoveRange.Hint: How far a token can move in one go, unless its Token config sets its own value.
F3D.Settings.AttackRange.Name: Default attack range (squares)
F3D.Settings.AttackRange.Hint: Width of the red band around the blue squares (1 = melee). Tokens can set their own.
F3D.Settings.Portraits.Name: Portraits above tokens
F3D.Settings.Portraits.Hint: Fire Emblem-style portrait of the token floating above its standee.
F3D.Settings.WallTextureFit.Name: Wall texture fit
F3D.Settings.WallTextureFit.Hint: Repeat: tiles keep the image's proportions (rectangular images aren't squashed), sized by the texture size. Wall height: the image spans the full wall height and repeats along the wall.
F3D.Settings.DoorTextureMode.Name: Door texture mode
F3D.Settings.DoorTextureMode.Hint: Fit: one image stretched over each door (for pictures of a door). Repeat: tiled like a wall.
F3D.WallConfig.DoorTextureHint: Image for this door in the 3D view. Empty: the door texture setting, or the module's wooden door.
F3D.WallConfig.TextureFitHint: How the texture covers this wall, and the tile size in squares (empty: the world settings).
F3D.Scene.ThemeHint: One click sets this scene's walls, doors, window frames, glass, sky and dust. The fields below override the theme.
F3D.Scene.SkyHint: Background colour of the 3D view (empty: the theme's, or the scene's).
F3D.Scene.Hint: Empty fields use the theme, then the world settings. A wall texture here switches this scene's walls to textures.
F3D.Settings.wallShading.Name: Shading at the base of walls
F3D.Settings.wallShading.Hint: Walls darken a little near the floor, for depth.
F3D.Settings.lightFlicker.Name: Flickering flames
F3D.Settings.lightFlicker.Hint: Lights animated as torches or flames in Foundry flicker in 3D too.
F3D.Settings.weather3d.Name: Weather in 3D
F3D.Settings.weather3d.Hint: The scene's weather (rain, snow, fog, leaves) falls in the 3D view.
F3D.Settings.dust3d.Name: Dust in the air
F3D.Settings.dust3d.Hint: Dust floating in the air in scenes whose theme asks for it (dungeons, caves).
